equipment_additions.name: Orthen furnace core + Superheat Form + smithing autoheater stack
equipment_additions.category: cross-region Smithing and Firemaking full AFK stack
requirements: Orthen furnace core (Anachronia): 99 Smithing, 102 Archaeology; 4 restored dragon burners from Orthen Observation outpost; 2 curved masterwork melee plates; listed consumable ingredients
Superheat Form (Tirannwn): The Light Within / Seren prayers, 91 Prayer, Ancient Curses active

Smithing autoheater (Forinthry / Daemonheim Rewards): base 35 Smithing + 35 Dungeoneering, 4,000 tokens; advanced upgrade 70 Smithing + 70 Dungeoneering + 40,000 tokens (advanced is the AFK stack partner)
Crystal hammer (Tirannwn) for the optimal tool half of the stack
Scroll of efficiency (Forinthry / Daemonheim) multiplies with furnace core bar-refund chance
effects: Furnace core off-hand: negates Superheat Form prayer drain when equipped before activating the prayer
Superheat Form: auto-burn logs while Woodcutting; faster smelting; low heat treated as medium and medium as high while smithing
Autoheater (esp. advanced): restores heat from metal-bank coal at 0% heat; with Superheat Form enables fully AFK medium-high heat smithing
Furnace core multiplies scroll of efficiency refund chance by 1.25 (2% → 2.5%)
Pyromaniac / Breakdown procs grant temporary Furnace Core XP status
unlocks: Fully AFK medium-high heat smithing when Orthen furnace core + Superheat Form + advanced smithing autoheater are all available
Sustained Superheat Form Firemaking/Woodcutting value without prayer-drain babysitting while the furnace core is equipped
Three-region combo pressure so planners score Anachronia + Tirannwn + Forinthry together for late AFK smithing/FM
region_pressure: Anachronia hard: Orthen Dig Site dragon burners and furnace-core craft (anachronia:orthen-furnace-core). Do not claim dual dig sites.
Tirannwn hard: Superheat Form and crystal hammer / crystal tinderbox tool half (tirannwn:superheat-form, tirannwn:crystal-hammer).
Forinthry hard: Daemonheim smithing autoheater (base + advanced) and scroll of efficiency permanent unlocks.

Asgarnia optional pressure: Artisans' Workshop curved masterwork melee plates / glorious-bar infrastructure consumed by the core craft (asgarnia:masterwork-smithing-chain / cross-region:masterwork-orthen-plate-pressure).
